name: Emiliasaura
sum: An iguanodontian ornithopod from the Early Cretaceous Mulichinco Formation of Neuquén, Argentina, known from three specimens.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; a partial ornithopod skeleton from the Mulichinco Formation, Pilmatué Creek, Neuquén.
material: Two further partial skeletons, one with much of the right hindlimb, parts of both pelvic girdles, sacral and caudal vertebrae and ossified tendons, and an isolated dorsal vertebra.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Coria et al. 2025
